parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ethernet0 unit 0 family i.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ethernet0 unit 0 family i.command: set interfaces ethernet0 unit 0 family inet address <ip-address>/<subnet-mask>
set interfaces ethernet0 unit 0 family i.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address <loopback-ip>/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options routes static route.template: set routing-options routes static route [parameter1]/[parameter2] next-hop [parameter3]
set routing-options routes static route.command: set routing-options routes static route <destination-network>/<netmask> next-hop <next-hop-ip>
set routing-options routes static route.explanation: 配置静态路由，指定目的网络和下一跳地址。

parameters.name: netmask
parameters.explanation: 目的网络的子网掩码位数。

set protocolsospf area 0 network <networ.explanation: 配置OSPF协议的Area 0的网络范围。
